change: New complete groups only; v13 prompt, model, effort, wrapper and input serialization unchanged.
prompt_template:
Write the most precise category title for the subject matter supported by every instance.

Interpret the quoted text within each instance together.

For each instance, ask yourself: "Given this instance alone, must it belong to the category named by this title?"

Instances:

{NUMBERED_INSTANCES}

groups.selection_rationale: Short topic words; check subject naming rather than input-format naming.
A broad instance accompanies several more specific instances; check unsupported specificity.
Related actions with differing methods and durations; check common meaning without inventing a shared method or duration.
Different dishes and added ingredients; check useful shared context without importing an ingredient into another instance.
Colloquial descriptions of contrasting mental states; check a shared subject without imposing one state on every instance.
Different abstract statements; check whether a supported shared subject can be named without inventing a relationship.

question: Does unchanged v13 produce supported, appropriately specific subject-category titles on a small diverse sample of previously unused complete HDBv2 groups?
evaluation: Read each mask's quoted text together; retain normal semantic interpretation.
Every mask must independently support membership in the named subject category; another mask must not supply missing specificity.
Judge a category of subject matter, not a class of keywords, text, tags or mentions.
Textual subjects remain valid when they actually are the subject matter.
A broad title can be correct when evidence does not support a narrower one; a category joined with and need not assert every item simultaneously.
Separate unsupported scope, describing input form, and avoidable loss of specific meaning; do not require exact reference strings.
Preserve assistant disagreements and every raw output; assign no user decisions.

novelty.comparison: All 102 prior title configs and result metadata across 12 experiment directories; eight prior source-packet files cover 18 original groups.
novelty.limitation: New groups and masks from the same original 100-note food-centered corpus, not a new corpus or wholly unseen notes.
novelty.audit: /root/v13_new_group_audit performed read-only input and metadata checks without inspecting generated titles.
novelty.duplicate_policy: Preserve complete original groups including exact duplicate V106/V105; no input repair or deduplication.

comparison: No historical same-group baseline. Both repetitions are preserved; no exact target titles are specified. This selected small sample is not a population accuracy estimate.
execution: One new isolated subscription-authenticated Codex process/thread/workspace per group and trial. Same CLI binary, wrapper, model, low effort, no schema or extra instructions. Numbered grouped quoted fragments unchanged; no full notes, expected titles, examples or prior responses supplied. Three concurrent calls maximum; no retry or best-of.
budget: Existing subscription allowance only; no API billing, rental, new purchase or credential changes.
